subtitle: Commercial doors, frames, and hardware since 1968.
paragraphs: General Building Products was founded in 1968. More than 55 years later, we still offer a full line of commercial doors and frames, plus all the hardware that goes with them.
Our complete hollow metal and door fabrication shop lets us build or modify to fit your unique situation, and we install hardware in-house before anything leaves our building.
Our staff includes a bonded locksmith and an AHC certified consultant, so you get expert help with everything from keying to hardware specifications.
